findings.statement: SBI Group's current documented strategy spans XRP-based remittance, XRP retail reward channels, Ripple RLUSD distribution, Circle USDC distribution, JPYSC issuance, Circle Arc founding validation and an XRPL tokenized-deposit concept proof. The evidence supports multi-rail participation, not exclusive allegiance to either Ripple or Circle.

SBI Remit's 2023 official release describes SBI VC Trade sending XRP in real time for remittance requests and Tranglo converting to local fiat for Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia bank-account corridors. This is stronger than an XRPL-only integration because XRP is explicitly the bridge asset. Current volume and 2026 activity remain unknown.

SBI offers XRP accumulation through monthly Visa-card point conversion, an XRP benefit on its sold-out JPY 10B START tokenized bond, and a past SBI Shinsei yen time-deposit campaign. These are real product mechanisms, but aggregate XRP distributions and market purchases are undisclosed.

SBI VC Trade launched RLUSD in Japan on June 24, 2026 and states it already supported Circle USDC since March 2025. Ripple says the launch followed JFSA regulatory approval; SBI VC Trade classifies RLUSD as a Type 4 electronic payment instrument under its Japanese-law treatment.
SBI VC Trade's RLUSD deposit/withdrawal service supported Ethereum only at launch. This is Ripple stablecoin distribution in Japan, but not evidence of XRPL RLUSD liquidity through SBI.

SBI Shinsei Trust Bank issued JPYSC, SBI VC Trade distributes it and Startale co-developed it. The September 7 update reports JPY 20.1B issued and JPY 1B allocated to Japanese government bonds; JPY 6.9B in lending applications are not completed loans.

SBI Ripple Asia is a Ripple joint venture with 60% SBI Group voting-rights ownership and announced a conceptual proof for tokenized deposits/deposit-type digital money using XRPL. It does not establish native XRP use in that design.
SBI VC Trade reported two million registered accounts as of July 6, 2026. This is platform distribution scale, not active users or XRP-specific holdings.
SBIC East Japan remains distinct from SBI Holdings/SBI Group. The newly documented SBI Group relationships do not establish any affiliation with SBIC East Japan.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI Group is executing a multi-rail strategy across XRP/Ripple, Circle/USDC/Arc, JPYSC and Visa rather than choosing one exclusive network.
supporting_evidence: SBI Remit XRP ODL corridors; SBI Ripple Asia XRPL PoC; SBI VC Trade RLUSD and USDC; JPYSC issuance; SBI Group Arc validator and USDC/JPYSC collaboration; Visa XRP rewards.
disconfirming_evidence: No public transaction-level route share or internal treasury allocation reveals which rail is preferred for each use case.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI Remit's XRP ODL corridors can create real XRP bridge-asset demand and turnover.
supporting_evidence: SBI's 2023 release explicitly says SBI VC Trade sends XRP in real time and XRP bridges JPY to local fiat via Tranglo for Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia.
disconfirming_evidence: No 2026 corridor volume, XRP turnover, market-maker inventory or share of remittance flow is disclosed; historical launch evidence is not a current volume series.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI's Visa card, tokenized bond and deposit campaign create incremental XRP acquisition demand.
supporting_evidence: Monthly card-point conversion, JPY 10B START bond with initial XRP benefit, and six-month yen deposit XRP coupon.
disconfirming_evidence: Rewards may be sourced from existing inventory or OTC; aggregate XRP quantity and market purchases are unknown; bond reward is small relative to principal and future benefits are not guaranteed.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI Ripple Asia's tokenized-deposit work can expand XRPL institutional usage without materially increasing native XRP demand.
supporting_evidence: SBI Ripple Asia's 2026 conceptual proof explicitly contemplates XRPL for tokenized deposits and deposit-type digital money.
disconfirming_evidence: No production launch, transaction count, fee demand, XRP bridge use or collateral use is disclosed.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI's RLUSD distribution strengthens Ripple's stablecoin reach in Japan but is initially separate from XRPL liquidity through SBI.
supporting_evidence: SBI VC Trade RLUSD launch and Ripple's JFSA approval statement.
disconfirming_evidence: SBI's initial supported chain is Ethereum only; no XRPL deposits/withdrawals through SBI at launch.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI VC Trade's simultaneous USDC, RLUSD and JPYSC distribution indicates a multi-stablecoin marketplace rather than exclusive Circle or Ripple distribution.
supporting_evidence: USDC available since March 2025; RLUSD launched June 2026; JPYSC distributed within SBI VC Trade accounts from June 2026.
disconfirming_evidence: No comparative balances, turnover, redemption flows or customer preference data are disclosed.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI's Circle Arc validator role and JPYSC/USDC collaboration could become a direct JPY-to-USD settlement route that competes with XRP bridge corridors.
supporting_evidence: Circle's Arc release names SBI Group as founding validator and describes USDC/JPYSC collaboration; StableFX offers 22 local stablecoins.
disconfirming_evidence: JPYSC is not in the 22-currency StableFX list; no live JPYSC Arc route or corridor volume is disclosed; SBI's XRP ODL relationships continue.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI VC Trade's two-million registered accounts provide a distribution channel for XRP and stablecoins.
supporting_evidence: Official SBI account-registration disclosure and multiple XRP/stablecoin products.
disconfirming_evidence: Registered accounts are not active/funded users, and no XRP ownership or trading-volume breakdown is published.

next_actions: Obtain public aggregate SBI Remit ODL volumes and current corridor status; do not infer from historical launch releases.
Measure actual XRP reward quantities distributed through SBI Visa card, SBI START bond and SBI Shinsei deposit campaign if issuer disclosures become available.
Verify whether SBI VC Trade adds XRPL RLUSD support; the current listing is Ethereum-only.
Monitor JPYSC public-chain availability, reserves, JGB holdings and completed lending rather than applications.
Determine whether JPYSC is added to Circle StableFX; JPYC and JPYSC must remain distinct.
Reconcile SBI Ripple Asia XRPL deposit proof-of-concept with any production implementation and native XRP fee/bridge use.
Continue Coinbase/Circle/Ripple/SBI institutional flow mapping and calibrated XRP model design.
